name: UI
summary: Screens and overlays: main menu, lobby, race settings, the in-race HUD, and controller-friendly widgets (Stepper), and the pit wall (StrategistScreen: timing, gaps, pit windows, weather radar, team radio feed). Co-op pit wall roles (CrewConsole: pit crew and strategist panels around the zoomed-out 3D race, combined for 2 players) and quick team radio calls (TeamRadio).
notes: Main menu scene: main_menu.tscn. SetupScreen: the controller-friendly car setup screen; SetupStore saves setups per car per track in user://setups/.
